items.title: Keep core Motoko SKILL.md generic; isolate or drop Caffeine-specific guidance
items.body:
Thanks for publishing these — great to have an actively maintained home for the Motoko skills!

Context: we maintain [dfinity/icskills](https://github.com/dfinity/icskills) (published at https://skills.internetcomputer.org). We currently sync our Motoko-category skills from `caffeinelabs/motoko` and are switching to `caffeinelabs/skills` (`writing-motoko`, `migrating-motoko-actors`, `troubleshooting-motoko-migrations`) now that the old skills are being retired.

Our site republishes these to a **general IC/Motoko** audience, not only Caffeine projects. Syncing goes smoothest — ideally additive-only, no per-release rewrites on our side — when the **core `SKILL.md` body is platform-generic** and Caffeine-platform specifics live in a **separate reference file we can skip**.

Today the following Caffeine-specific material is interleaved into the core `writing-motoko` / `migrating-motoko-actors` bodies:

- `caffeine check --fix` / `caffeine build` presented as build commands
- `pnpm bindgen` for frontend bindings
- `mops add caffeineai-<name>` component packages and `Load extension-<name>` skill references (`extension-oql`, `extension-object-storage`, …) — these skills only exist inside `caffeinelabs/skills`
- The "draft canister" framing (e.g. "Draft canisters do not own their cycles")
- `caffeineai-subscription:` frontmatter

**Request:** would you be open to keeping the core `SKILL.md` body toolchain-generic (mops / `moc` / `mo:core`) and either

- moving Caffeine-platform specifics into e.g. `references/caffeine.md` (linked from the core skill), or
- dropping the Caffeine-specific bits from these three skills entirely,

whichever fits your maintenance model best — that's entirely your call. Either way lets downstream consumers sync the core verbatim.

Happy to open a PR if a concrete proposal would help.

_(Related: a separate issue about the absolute "never send cycles" wording, which is one specific instance of Caffeine-draft guidance in the general body.)_
